question: Where is the nearest restaurant along the direction of travel from Sea Life Aquarium, San Antonio, TX to the Cross at Kerrville, Kerrville, TX?
sql: WITH origin_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sea Life Aquarium%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%San Antonio%' LIMIT 1 ), destination_poi AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cross at Kerrville%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Kerrville%' LIMIT 1 ), travel_info AS ( SELECT ST_Centroid(o.geometry) AS origin_point, ST_Centroid(d.geometry) AS destination_point, degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(o.geometry), ST_Centroid(d.geometry))) AS bearing_ab FROM origin_poi o, destination_poi d ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, ST_Distance(t.origin_point, p.geometry::geography) AS distance_from_origin FROM pois p, travel_info t WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' -- Ensure the restaurant is not the origin itself or extremely close to it (e.g., within 10 meters) AND ST_Distance(t.origin_point, p.geometry::geography) > 10 -- Filter restaurants that are "along the direction" (within +/- 30 degrees of the travel bearing) AND LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(t.origin_point, ST_Centroid(p.geometry))) - t.bearing_ab), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(t.origin_point, ST_Centroid(p.geometry))) - t.bearing_ab) ) <= 30 ORDER BY ST_Distance(t.origin_point, p.geometry::geography) ASC LIMIT 1;
